evidence.note: Proves that early-stopped gradient descent for overparameterized logistic regression achieves bounded excess logistic risk and polynomial sample complexity for minimal zero-one risk, while asymptotic (fully converged) GD has statistically inconsistent, unboundedly growing excess risk and requires exponential sample complexity for interpolating solutions, and derives quantitative bounds connecting early-stopped GD to explicit L2-regularized solutions.
evidence.title: Benefits of Early Stopping in Gradient Descent for Overparameterized Logistic Regression
